init_BaseGraphNeuralNetworkLayer: initialize a BaseGraphNeuralNetworkLayer with global, molecular graph, GNN, and regularization configs
get_edge_features: compute concatenated edge features from atomic embeddings, direction embeddings, and distance embeddings
get_edge_linear: build a linear layer for edge features combining distance, direction, and atom embeddings
get_node_features: compute concatenated sender and receiver node features using the neighbor list
aggregate: aggregate edge features by selecting the first neighbor using the neighbor mask
